title: platform-checklist accuracy and fixture gaps from the #23104 browser pass, successor of #23121: the rows #23132 did not land (family card)
body:
Filing-gate category ③ — the maintainer's order in the dispatching session of #23104, verbatim: 「测试遇到的问题，可以提交issue」.

**Successor of #23121.** That family card was claimed for its first six rows and closed (completed) when PR #23132 landed them as `1ca7a805c`. Two rows were appended to it after that claim and never landed, and the browser pass's two run records (#23163 `surface:browser`, #23166 `surface:mixed`) parked 59 more rows on it after it closed. Those rows are this card's whole scope; nothing in #23121's landed six is reopened here.

**Reader who acts:** whichever seat owns `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` edits (#23121 was triaged `domain:skills` · `tooling`) — revise each item, bump its `revision`, append `history`, keep `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` green. Each row is independently checkable; product defects from the same pass are NOT here (they are filed on their own cards, listed on #23104). **Dedupe:** the predecessor is #23121 (closed); the rows below were checked against its landed diff (`1ca7a805c`) — none of them is in it.

## Rows appended to #23121 after its claim (never landed)

| QA-source | disposition | what the clause pins | what the product does, and why that is right |
|---|---|---|---|
| `#23104 · platform-core.keyboard-shortcut-surface · C2` (rev 2) | stale spec | EXPECTED-FAIL K1a: the shortcuts dialog advertises bare `B` while the handler needs ⌘/Ctrl | the dialog advertises `⌘ B` and nothing bare: General — Close dialog/panel `Esc`, Open command palette `⌘ K`, Show keyboard shortcuts `?`; Navigation — Toggle sidebar `⌘ B`. Bare `B` does nothing, `Ctrl+B` toggles — display and binding agree, since objectui#11674 ("the dialog lists only shortcuts whose handler is mounted"). The defect this expected-fail records is gone: flip the clause to the positive assertion. |
| `#23104 · platform-core.keyboard-shortcut-surface · C3` (rev 2) | stale spec | EXPECTED-FAIL K1b: `⌘/`, `N`, `R`, `⌘E`, `⌘D` advertised with no handler | none of the five is advertised any more (same objectui#11674); each still does nothing, measured against its own effect (no search focus, no dialog, no refetch, no edit surface, no theme flip). "Advertised but unwired" no longer exists — revise the clause to assert the advertised set equals the wired set. |

## Rows from the two run records (parked on #23121 after it closed)

Evidence for each row is in the record named in its first column; revisions are the ones the run judged.

| QA-source | kind | what the item says | what the run found / the edit it suggests |
|---|---|---|---|
| `#23163 · records-forms.saved-view-management · A0` (rev 1) | stale spec | steps 0–1: create a view, and it is live after reload | the Create View dialog is draft-first (`PUT …?mode=draft`, lands on `?preview=draft`), and the view goes live only after Publish (`POST …/publish`). Add the publish leg. Rename / default / pin / delete write the live overlay directly. |
| `#23163 · records-forms.list-view-capabilities · A6` (rev 1) | fixture gap | export as the seeded admin | no stock permission set grants `allowExport` (export is opt-in): Export is hidden and the route answers 403 EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED. Add a provisioning note: a runtime set `{object_permissions.showcase_task:{allowRead, allowExport}}` bound through `sys_user_permission_set` by the set's NAME. |
| `#23163 · records-forms.record-edit-undo · A0–A3` (rev 2) | fixture gap | "an inline edit or an action flagged undoable" | at objectui `1fb1ced36243` inline edits push no Undo op; only `undoable` actions do. The showcase declares none, and runtime-authored actions are not served. Ship a packaged `undoable` action (operation update + patch); the item stays BLOCKED until then. |
| `#23163 · records-forms.action-location-matrix · A4` (rev 9) | fixture gap | step 6(a): a runtime-authored, locations-less probe action | runtime-authored actions are not joined into the served object's `actions[]` (the positive control was invisible too), so the probe proves nothing. Use a packaged specimen, as with `showcase_new_task`. |
| `#23163 · records-forms.bulk-select-all-matching` (rev 2) | stale fixture | `showcase_contact` bulk actions; 26 contacts exceed a page | `showcase_contact` declares no bulkActions, and its 34 contacts fit page 1 (50 rows). The run re-pointed to the `showcase_task` "Bulk Actions" view with 55 scratch tasks. Re-point the item. |
| `#23163 · records-forms.form-view-gallery` (rev 2) | fixture gap | overlay recipe `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.form?mode=draft` | without item-level `isDefault:true`, publish drops the flag and the console falls back to the all-fields layout (objectui#11539). Add it to the recipe. |
| `#23163 · records-forms.form-dirty-guard · A2` (rev 2) | assertion defect | verify `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form exec vitest run src/discardGuard.test.tsx` | refused by objectui's vitest guard (objectui#3378). Use `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/discardGuard.test.tsx` from the objectui root (14/14 there). |
| `#23163 · records-forms.import-wizard-encoding-and-hints · A0` (rev 5) | assertion defect | verify `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid exec vitest run src/…` | the same objectui#3378 refusal. Run from the objectui root. |
| `#23163 · records-forms.form-dirty-guard · A0` (rev 2) | wording | step 1 / negative: closing a dirty form prompts | the footer Cancel discards without a prompt by design (`ModalForm.tsx` L739, pinned in `discardGuard.test.tsx`). Distinguish the deliberate Cancel from X / Escape. |
| `#23163 · records-forms.gantt-interactions · A2-leaf` (rev 3) | fixture gap | drag on a locked leaf bar | the stock gantt view has no lockField, no pin reaches a locked leaf, and the knownGaps view-overlay recipe is not run-proven. |
| `#23163 · dashboards.global-filters-rescope · D2 / D3` (rev 3) | fixture gap | dataset-sourced filter options; field override | no stock dashboard declares a globalFilter with `optionsFrom`, and D2 needs a writable package. Both were scored on runtime scratch dashboards; add them to fixtures.requires. |
| `#23163 · ux-conventions.write-feedback` (rev 1) | knownGaps stale | objectui#11817 (Invite feedback), objectui#11807 (Studio Publish), objectui#11816 (inline no-op dirty); quoted "Invitation sent" | all three are fixed at the pin. Invite toasts "Invitation sent to EMAIL", the declared successMessage interpolating the result email. Studio discard lives on the metadata designer (Discard draft, native confirm), not the pillars, and a scratch object needs the namespace prefix. |
| `#23163 · ux-conventions.write-feedback · A5` (rev 1) | fixture gap | Undo offered on feedback | no stock surface offers Undo (same root as record-edit-undo). |
| `#23163 · ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason` (rev 1) | knownGap stale | objectui#11811 (Archive has no reason); Studio Publish as the known PASS | Archive now carries a tooltip and aria-describedby on a focusable wrapper. The Publish calibration holds for hover only: its title sits on a disabled button with no focusable wrapper. |
| `#23163 · ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names` (rev 1) | knownGaps partly stale | objectui#11866, objectui#11778, objectui#11862 | objectui#11866 is fixed. objectui#11778 is fixed for the Node Type value. objectui#11862 is fixed for the Explain principal line and the nav editor, but still reproduces for the Access permission-set list and the Changes panel. |
| `#23163 · search.command-palette-navigation · A4` (rev 2) | knownGaps update | visibility-predicate recipe unproven | the scratch-copy recipe (visible `'true'` / `'false'` nav leaves) is run-proven at `36b2889c` + `1fb1ced36243`. |
| `#23163 · i18n.surface-matrix` (rev 6) | knownGap stale | tabbed form at `…/view/tabbed`; record-page sections render EN in every locale | `…/view/tabbed` renders the grid. Named sections render zh on the New form, the task record page and the contact form, so the knownGap is stale. |
| `#23163 · i18n.studio-follows-app-locale · A2` (rev 4) | stale step | step 4: relative dates on metadata list / history | there are none there (history is absolute). Relative dates live on the Studio Data pillar's records grid (6天前). |
| `#23163 · access-security.share-link-landing-page · C3` (rev 1) | knownGap stale | knownGaps[2]: the `signed_in` audience falls to the password prompt | the console renders a dedicated "Sign in required" state for SIGN_IN_REQUIRED, and the item asks to be revised when this happens. |
| `#23163 · api-backend.api-console-discovery-execute · C0` (rev 1) | stale step | step 1: Studio → Developer → API Console | that nav exists only in `studio.app.ts` (`nav_api_console`), which a stock boot does not load. Reach `/_console/apps/setup/developer/api-console` by deep link. |
| `#23163 · ai.console-ai-surface-gating · C5` (rev 3) | stale spec | EXPECTED-FAIL K2: empty queue under the 501 alert, and a poll that never backs off | fixed (objectui#11736): one 501 read, no re-arm, no empty state under the alert. Drop the expected-fail wording. |
| `#23163 · platform-core.keyboard-shortcut-surface · C4` (rev 2) | stale premise | ⌘⇧O / ⌘⇧S listed globally but page-scoped | not listed in the global dialog at all; the AI-chat rows appear only while AiChatPage's handler is mounted (objectui#11674). Fold into the open C2 / C3 revision. |
| `#23163 · platform-core.theme-mode-persistence · C0` (rev 1) | stale step text | storage key `vite-ui-theme`; ModeToggle in the AppHeader | the key is `object-ui-theme` (`ConsoleShell.tsx:157`), and ModeToggle lives under the avatar menu › Preferences (`AppHeader.tsx:999`). Also reported on #21782's closeout; still rev 1. |
| `#23163 · platform-core.marketplace-console-honesty` (rev 3) | setup recipe gap | per-boot `OS_HOME` + `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT` isolate a boot | `install-local` caches the manifest under the working directory's `.objectstack/installed-packages`, so an install from the shared tree lands in it. Items that install a package (this one and `platform-core.marketplace-install-local-lifecycle`) must boot from a scratch copy; RUNNER's environment facts should say so. |
| `#23163 · approvals.notification-deep-link · A0` (rev 5) | assertion defect | step 1: `POST …/remind` as the dev admin on a seeded request | remind is submitter-only (403 "only the submitter may send reminders"), and the admin is an approver. Use the opening path or `/reassign`. |
| `#23163 · approvals.quorum-m-of-n · A0` (rev 4) | fixture gap (known) | the stock `showcase_committee_quorum` exercises M-of-N | every slot resolves to the admin, clamping 2-of-3 to 1-of-1. The item was scored on the runtime-fixture recipe from #21845; ship a fixture with distinct holders. |
| `#23163 · automation.screen-flow-roundtrip · A0` (rev 3) | stale spec | verify: a POST matching `/automation/[^/]+/trigger` | the console launches through `POST /api/v1/actions/OBJECT/ACTION`, which runs the flow and returns the pause. The paused-run contract holds. |
| `#23163 · automation.setup-packaged-automation-board · A7` (rev 2) | maintainer question | a plain member reaches the page and sees the switches; activation reads are open | at this build the member cannot open the setup app, and the activation read answers 403. Recorded, not adjudicated, as the clause asks. |
| `#23163 · studio-authoring.packaged-automation-studio-lock · A2 / A3` (rev 1) | stale spec | knownGaps[0] and "CURRENT RECORDED FINDING": a clickable switch the server refuses | both the switch and the inspector honour readOnly (disabled with a reason title; a forced click sends nothing). Drop the expected-fail wording. |
| `#23163 · integration-system.flow-connector-picker · A0` (rev 3) | knownGap stale | an installed-package lock on the editable flow | an env-wide flow authored through `POST /api/v1/automation` opens editable, with no lock banner. |
| `#23166 · identity-auth.workspace-org-switch` (rev 2) | fixture gap | fixtures.requires: `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group/isolated` | a walled posture refuses to boot without `@objectstack/organizations` declared in the host `package.json` (ADR-0093 D5), `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`, and `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY`. With invite-only, the invitee must also `accept-invitation`. |
| `#23166 · identity-auth.workspace-org-switch · C3b` (rev 2) | stale spec | the meta half: an id existing only in the previous org is absent | metadata writes are deployment-level ("no metadata write is organization-scoped any more", `protocol.ts`), so no org-only metadata id exists. Re-ground the clause. |
| `#23166 · platform-core.lifecycle-retention-sweep · C1` (rev 1) | stale step + ruling owed | step 3 greps the `[lifecycle]` line; step 5: an idle sweep logs nothing | the line is INFO and `os dev` defaults to warn, so it needs `OS_LOG_LEVEL=info`. An idle sweep still logs "18 policy(ies) applied, ~0 rows reaped": `report.swept` gets an entry per applied policy (`lifecycle-service.ts:1705`), and the print gate tests `swept.length` (`:781`). Stale step or product defect? A ruling is owed. |
| `#23166 · identity-auth.email-verification-loop · C2` (rev 2) | stale step | a POST verify-email variant | `POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email` answers 404; the console uses GET `?token=` (`VerifyEmailPage.tsx:47-56`). |
| `#23166 · cli.scaffold-first-run · C2` (rev 3) | stale wording | verify: "each of the six templates" | the variants have been `[blank]` since rev 2, and the published scaffolder offers only blank. |
| `#23166 · records-forms.field-group-visible-when · A3` (rev 2) | stale spec | the detail half is expected to FAIL (objectui#11630) | the detail page gates the group per record at the pin. |
| `#23166 · dashboards.system-overview-live-counts · A1 / A3` (rev 1) | stale spec | A1 caveat "no active-only filter"; A3 names `widget_organizations` and a permission KPI | the Active Sessions widget filters revoked_at null and expires_at > now. `system_overview` declares 8 widgets, with no `widget_organizations` and no permission-events KPI. |
| `#23166 · records-forms.object-hook-lifecycle · A7` (rev 3) | wording drift | log `[hook] async handler error (fire-and-forget)` | the log reads `ERROR [hook] handler failed (onError=log; suppressing)`. |
| `#23166 · search.console-global-search · A5` (rev 3) | persona recipe gap | `search:qa-contributor-bound-member` step 5 owns an invoice | a member-created `showcase_invoice` is invisible to its creator unless `owner` is set to the member's email (`invoice_own_rows` reads owner == current_user.email). The same class applies to `showcase_task` (assignee). |
| `#23166 · search.console-global-search · A6` (rev 3) | stale step | step 6: Open Full Search Page from the palette | it is offered only for an empty query or one matching "search all results full page". Reach `/search` by URL or through that query. |
| `#23166 · attachments-storage.download-authz-both-sides · A4` (rev 3) | persona recipe gap | qa-scratch-authz step 6, persona B | B also needs `sys_attachment` read, or the panel refuses before any download is attempted. |
| `#23166 · approvals.ooo-delegation-reroute · A0` (rev 4) | assertion defect | steps 3–4: an autolaunched flow via `POST /api/v1/automation/FLOW/trigger` | that route cannot open an approval: `buildAutomationContext` maps the record into params only, the engine seeds `$record` from `context.record`, and the answer is 400 "no record id in $record". Use a record-triggered start. |
| `#23166 · studio-authoring.custom-page-source-tiers · A5` (rev 1) | assertion defect (minor) | step 8 / knownGaps[0]: the html compile-error panel on the rendered page | the server compiles html at save / publish (422 INVALID_METADATA), so a faulty html page never publishes. The panel is reachable only in the designer's draft preview. |
| `#23166 · studio-authoring.metadata-diagnostics-sweep · A1` (rev 2) | stale spec | "locked counts rows whose _lock != none" | `stats.locked` is the served envelope lock (#21694). Compare against the item envelope's lock. |
| `#23166 · studio-authoring.object-designer-roundtrip · A3` (rev 2) | assertion defect | step 4: no banner for an empty picklist row | with no real option yet, the select-needs-options banner fires (the empty rows ARE dropped), and objectui's F4 `toHaveCount(0)` collides the same way. Assert with real options present. |
| `#23166 · studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip · A0` (rev 3) | stale step | step 1: Label + Object + Save | Page type now defaults to `list`. Add "set Page type = record". |
| `#23166 · studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle · A8` (rev 4) | assertion defect | step 10: `?from=1&to=2` | history counts draft saves and publishes, so v1 → v2 is a draft and its own publish (`changed []`); the published revisions were v2 and v4. Name the publish versions read off `/history`. |
| `#23166 · studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu · A0` (rev 1) | knownGap stale | the doc editor refuses the read-only package with 422 | it saves an env-wide draft and offers no package picker. Drive the writable base over `?package=` so the books and docs share one package. |
| `#23166 · automation.flow-runs-page-test-trigger · A2` (rev 1) | assertion defect (minor) | step 6: fill recordId + new_assignee | supplying `new_assignee` completes the run without pausing. Leave it empty to exercise the hand-off. |
| `#23166 · automation.flow-node-type-matrix · A1` (rev 4) | recipe note | notify steps on run-created records | tasks and projects created without an assignee or owner fail notify loudly, which is a correct refusal. Set an assignee in the recipe. |
| `#23166 · integration-system.webhook-lifecycle · A1` (rev 5) | stale spec | steps 2–3 enable the shipped `showcase_task_changed` | it materializes org-less, so on the org-walled showcase it never fans out, while Setup reads active:true. Author it inside the organization, or org-stamp the fixture. |
| `#23166 · integration-system.webhook-lifecycle · A2 / N1 / N2` (rev 5) | dependency + coverage gap | aggregate bulk delivery; unknown-trigger and connector tombstones | A2 is blocked: in-org bulk flow events carry no organizationId, and the org-owned subscription refuses them (maintainer question, in #23166). N1 / N2 were not attempted (time budget); a re-run is owed. |
| `#23166 · integration-system.email-template-render · A0 / A5 / A6` (rev 5) | stale spec | templates materialize to `sys_email_template`; the fixture line names `category` | `sys_email_template` holds 0 rows: the registry serves the item, and the email-template door closes the table. Rewrite step 1 and A5 against `GET /api/v1/meta/email_template/NAME`. `category` is retired. A5's declared-source half needs a writable showcase copy. |
| `#23166 · integration-system.external-schema-browser-ui · A1 / A4` (rev 2) | stale spec | 5 columns each; knownGap "ValidationPanel lacks unreachable" | the fixture carries 7 columns (API and panel agree), and `ValidationPanel.tsx` maps unreachable at the pin. |
| `#23166 · identity-auth.implicit-account-linking-ownership · C3` (rev 1) | fixture note | a second identity re-points U's sub | the local IdP derives `sub` from the email, so W's identity is a distinct sub. |
| `#23166 · studio-authoring.metadata-diagnostics-sweep · A6` (rev 2) | fixture gap (in knownGaps) | an invalid stored row | not plantable on a stock boot, because every save door validates. Pending a stale-row DB snapshot fixture. |
| `#23166 · approvals.decision-action-matrix · A9-wire` (rev 4) | fixture gap (in knownGaps) | the live 500 `APPROVAL_ACTION_FAILED` envelope | needs an org-less request, which no stock flow opens on demand. |
| `#23166 · integration-system.notify-inbox-delivery · A3-501` (rev 2) | fixture gap (in knownGaps) | the 501 capability-unavailable arm | needs a boot without MessagingServicePlugin, and the showcase requires messaging. |
| `#23166 · integration-system.notification-preference-suppression · A3-mandatory` (rev 1) | fixture gap | the mandatoryTopics bypass | the stock showcase declares none, and they are not runtime-writable. |
